WITH claim AS (
 UPDATE email_drafts d SET status='sending', updated_at=now()
 WHERE d.id=$1::uuid AND d.thread_id=$2::uuid AND d.revision=$3::integer
   AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.status='approved' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.email_approvals a WHERE a.draft_id=d.id AND a.revision=d.revision AND a.approved_at>now()-interval '9 minutes' AND a.provider_review IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.email_draft_revisions approved_version WHERE approved_version.draft_id=d.id AND approved_version.revision=d.revision AND approved_version.body=d.current_body AND approved_version.to_addresses=d.to_addresses AND approved_version.subject=d.subject) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.email_threads current_thread WHERE current_thread.id=d.thread_id AND current_thread.message_version=d.source_message_version) AND nullif(trim(d.current_body),'') IS NOT NULL
   AND EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM email_messages m
     JOIN email_threads t ON t.id=d.thread_id
     JOIN email_mailboxes mb ON mb.id=t.mailbox_id
     WHERE m.id=d.reply_to_message_id AND m.thread_id=d.thread_id AND m.mailbox_id=t.mailbox_id
       AND m.direction='incoming' AND nullif(m.provider_ref,'') IS NOT NULL
       AND lower(m.sender) <> ALL(string_to_array($4,';'))
       AND lower(d.to_addresses->>0) <> ALL(string_to_array($4,';'))
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(m.to_addresses) recipient
                   WHERE lower(recipient) = ANY(string_to_array($4,';')))
       AND lower(mb.address)=lower($5)
       AND jsonb_array_length(d.to_addresses)=1
       AND lower(d.to_addresses->>0)=lower(m.sender)
   )
 RETURNING d.*
)
SELECT claim.id AS draft_id, claim.thread_id, claim.revision, claim.current_body,
 claim.subject, claim.to_addresses, claim.reply_to_message_id,
 m.provider_ref AS reply_provider_ref, t.mailbox_id, t.provider_thread_key, mb.address AS mailbox_address
FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN claim ON true
LEFT JOIN email_messages m ON m.id=claim.reply_to_message_id
LEFT JOIN email_threads t ON t.id=claim.thread_id
LEFT JOIN email_mailboxes mb ON mb.id=t.mailbox_id;
